ResourceHeader.ResourceName: Hinode SOT-FG Level 0 Focus Scan FITS Data (FGFOCUS)

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial metadata creation and publication. SY

ResourceHeader.Description: The Hinode Solar Optical Telescope Filtergraph (SOT-FG) Level 0 FGFOCUS FITS data product contains uncalibrated, two-dimensional filtergram images acquired during focus-scan observations. The product is identified by DataCode FGFOCUS and OBS_TYPE='FG focus scan', distinguishing it from routine filtergrams and other SOT-FG products. The images are acquired sequentially at different focus settings during focus scans, with the focus setting recorded by the FITS header keyword FOCUS. The inspected FITS files include observations from the Broadband Filter Imager (BFI; FITS INSTRUME='SOT/WB') and Narrowband Filter Imager (NFI; FITS INSTRUME='SOT/NB'). The FITS header records the focus setting in the FOCUS keyword, along with the observing passband in WAVE, exposure information, and image sampling. Spatial dimensions vary with observing settings, including subframing and binning. The images have not undergone ground-based scientific calibration.

Parameter.Name: Focus Scan Filtergram Images
Parameter.Description: Two-dimensional Level 0 SOT-FG focus-scan filtergram images stored in the FITS Primary HDU. Observations are made with the BFI or NFI at focus settings recorded by the FITS FOCUS keyword. The observing passband is indicated by the FITS WAVE keyword; the inspected samples include G-band images and NFI images labeled NFI no move. The images are not a continuous wavelength scan.
